initial_campaign.reason: The raw serve bypass probe now uses dedicated OS pipes, so only the admission-required refusal can satisfy it. The full final campaign uses captured controller hashes and fresh jobs; initial histories are retained.

limits: Admission is mandatory for newly signed policy-3 jobs and their required owners. Legacy policy-2 and V1 histories are not activated, migrated or cleared.
The full Admit-ending binding is historical, not an online current-head grant. Original source, volatile session, one-use consumed and Claim/no-claim exclusion gates remain essential.

Independent one-history enrollment, protected keys/RAM and external pins are required. Local placement checks do not fence deliberate re-enrollment, hostile implementations, copied RAM or rollback of all pins.
Four logical witnesses split 2/2 across two observed kernels are not four independently protected failure domains; keys are public deterministic test fixtures.
The controller uses the operator channel to distribute admission. Automatic durable outbox/RPC delivery and activation/cutover/accounting bridge remain open.

Network/process loss and injected sync faults are not physical power-loss or device-exhaustion acceptance. Safe split-vote progress, external review and sustained adversarial public testnet gates remain open.
Published consumed/pending wrappers contain public candidate/QC/bundle/IDs only. They are historical local records, not live source ownership or execution permission.
